decision.article_title: [2026국감]“실제 얼굴 안 써도 닮으면 침해”…AI 퍼블리시티권 보호 사각지대 우려 - 전자신문
decision.reason: South Korea October parliamentary review identified 74 publicity-right complaints and ambiguous rules for synthetic lookalikes, with many cases untraceable. Rights-owner evidence intake/takedown queue is a non-model workflow distinct from publisher-side source disclosure; new candidate needs validation.

opportunities.idea_name: AI Likeness Claim & Takedown Evidence Desk
opportunities.core_job: Track rightsholder notice and human review of synthesized lookalike/voice complaints with evidence and platform takedown follow-ups
opportunities.target_customer: Talent agencies, performer legal/IP rightsholders and brand abuse response teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Alleged content URL/video details → consent/rights scope → human reviewed likelihood and legal basis (no automatic biometric matching) → platform appeal/removal steps → evidentiary case closure
opportunities.why_now: 2026-10-13 Korean National Assembly audit notes AI-synthesized celebrity resemblance, unclear publicity rights enforcement and low successful investigation among 74 agency-reported incidents
opportunities.before_state: Talent agencies manually share alleged deepfake likeness links and notice emails without verifiable case tracking
opportunities.after_state: Versioned manual evidence chain for lookalike/voice claims and removal, no AI inference or biometric scraping
